bc_readme.note: Table 7 uses log10 dissociation pK in Pa. The actual table headers give 700 K; the column prose says 750 K. Use the headers.

bc_paper.scope: Equations 1 and 7, Sections 2.1 and 3; nuclear-spin products excluded, molecular spin-orbit neglected. Underlying D0 experiments not all independently reaudited.

janaf_note: Primary NIST gas tables, evaluated at the listed dates. Numerical excerpts were read from HTML via a text retrieval tool; no original-HTML hash is asserted. Use H(298)+sensible H-T*S for balanced reactions; the old HS formation columns do not combine consistently with the other tables; the historical cause is not traced.

atct.note: Pinned evaluated thermochemical network, not a claim of the latest ATcT version. Gas ground states and natural isotopic abundance; HCN and HNC are separate. Values are displayed precision; no covariance matrix or full-temperature thermodynamic functions. COS was not verified in this excerpt. Later 1.228 entries were discovered but not used to mix network versions.

VO.inspection: Author abstract indexed at PubMed; four R3PI intermediate states. Full experimental/systematic-error analysis not reaudited.
VO.citation: Merriles et al. (2020), J. Chem. Phys. 153, 024303

MgH.inspection: Primary author abstract: D0 = 10365.6 +/- 0.5 cm^-1, distinct from De = 11104.7 cm^-1. Representative-isotopologue energy; uncertainty does not cover the natural-abundance hybrid.
MgH.citation: Shayesteh et al. (2007), J. Phys. Chem. A 111, 12495-12505
MgH.followup_note: Henderson et al. (2013) refine De to 11104.25 +/- 0.8 cm^-1. The checked 2007 D0 is retained at this stage; the 2013 full D0/isotopologue extraction remains open, rather than substituting De for D0.

CaH_review.scope: Shayesteh and Ghazizadeh (2017), pp. 647 and 651: De fixed at 14300 cm^-1; data cannot determine an accurate dissociation energy. This is not a measured D0. Supports rejection of an automatic switch to BC D0 = 2.281 eV.

FeH_review.scope: DeYonker and Allen (2012), author abstract: computed D0 = 1.86 eV. A conflicting theoretical value, not grounds to declare BC D0 = 1.497 eV experimentally validated.

tih_burrows.scope: Table 13 and Appendix A; X-state spin components resolved, some excited-state constants estimated. The source Ti atomic partition is truncated at 20000 cm^-1; H partition is two. No 300-6000 K validity inferred for the FastChem fit.
